title: A refinement of the asymptotic expansion of Weil-Petersson volumes
summary: Over the past decade, the study of the asymptotic growth of Weil-Petersson volumes of the moduli space of hyperbolic surfaces has yielded numerous results on the length spectrum and on the spectrum of the Laplacian of typical large genus surfaces.
